title: Seagrove Beach "Paradise City" 115 Santa Clara
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 200 yards to the beach- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $35 per day**- Spacious balconies- Propane Grill- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Foosball table- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Close to the beach! Paradise City is a 5-bedroom, 6-and-a-half-bathroom Seagrove Beach home that sleeps 20. Guests will love the enclosed private pool, game room, large balconies, and being in the heart of Seagrove Beach.On the first floor of Paradise City is an enclosed, L-shaped pool that can be heated on coolnights. A wall-mounted 65” TV lets guests enjoy a favorite show while floating or loungingpoolside.On the second floor are 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms, and an open kitchen, living, and dining area. A coffered ceiling, pale hardwood floors, and a soft color palette create a relaxing space for guests to gather and enjoy time together. The sparkling white kitchen has a 6-burner gas cooktop and range, stainless steel appliances, and a dine-in island that seats 4. The comfy living and dining area features 2 sofas, armchairs surrounding a 65” TV in the living area, and an oversized dining table with views of the balcony. French doors open to a large balcony with beautiful wooded views, a gas grill, and an outdoor dining table.A game room, the primary bedroom, and additional guest rooms are on the third floor. At the stair landing are 2 adorable twin-over-twin bunks beds and a spacious game room with a foosball table! A wrap-around sofa is a perfect spot to cheer a foosball game or watch a movie on a 55” TV. Off the game room is a spacious balcony with wooded views and another wrap-around sofa. A guest bedroom has a queen bed, and a bunk room has 2 full-over-full bunkbeds. The spacious primary bedroom has a king bed and a lovely bathroom with a soaking tub and shower behind a glass enclosure.Guests can tote beach gear on an included 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle or explore Seagrove Beach on 5 included adult bikes. Guests will love the location and comfortable interiors of Paradise City. Reserve today before this beauty books up!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 20):FIRST FLOOR- Private PoolSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlyTHIRD FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Dual Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Bedroom: Two Full-over-Full Bunk beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Area: Two Twin over Twin Bunk beds, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home.*Construction in the area is expected to continue through 2026

Paradise City is a 5-bedroom, 6-and-a-half-bathroom Seagrove Beach home that sleeps 20. Guests will love the enclosed private pool, game room, large balconies, and being in the heart of Seagrove Beach. On the first floor of Paradise City is an enclosed, L-shaped pool that can be heated on cool nights. A wall-mounted 65” TV lets guests enjoy a favorite show while floating or lounging poolside. On the second floor are 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms, and an open kitchen, living, and dining area. A coffered ceiling, pale hardwood floors, and a soft color palette create a relaxing space for guests to gather and enjoy time together. The sparkling white kitchen has a 6-burner gas cooktop and range, stainless steel appliances, and a dine-in island that seats 4. At the stair landing are 2 adorable twin-over-twin bunks beds and a spacious game room with a foosball table! A guest bedroom has a queen bed, and a bunk room has 2 full-over-full bunk beds. The spacious primary bedroom has a king bed and a lovely bathroom with a soaking tub and shower behind a glass enclosure. Guests can tote beach gear on an included 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle or explore Seagrove Beach on 5 included adult bikes. Guests will love the location and comfortable interiors of Paradise City. Reserve today before this beauty books up!
